if.u_query: Absorb the Count’s flesh? It will begin changing your body forever.

then.u_message: The flesh dissolves beneath your skin. The change has begun and will continue on its own. Find water, food and a place to rest.

else.u_message: The flesh remains in your hands. Your body cannot accept this path, or another change has already taken root.
